verdict.rationale: First-party WorkOS material lists passkeys and Magic Auth among AuthKit's built-in sign-in methods, and describes passwordless sign-in with a six-digit email code. That covers both passkeys and email OTP as first-class methods. The evidence is only short marketing and pricing lines, with no dedicated configuration docs. Missing for 10: in-depth passkey/WebAuthn setup and API documentation, evidence of link-style magic links, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods

citations.quote: AuthKit includes email + password, social login, passkeys, MFA, magic auth, and enterprise SSO — all from one integration.
Single sign-on, passkeys, social sign-in, passwords, and more.
Passwordless auth with a six-digit code sent via email
